audio_changed.tungsten-thunder-horse (unstable/pedals/: RESOLVED at e53573c — RE-CONVERGED to main. The 83bf48d idle-collapse regression (silence +5.8 dB corr -0.002 / step +10.5 dB corr -0.12) is gone; the e53573c line-search-failure fix (arbiter-endorsed) restores the idle noise floor and levels. vs main now: silence -0.012 dB (corr 0.9978), step -0.004 dB (corr 0.9992), sweep +0.017 dB (corr 0.9926); sine1k + potsweep NEGLIGIBLE (corr 1.0). NOT bit-identical to main, so silence/step/sweep still trip the strict CHANGED classifier at tiny magnitude; the residual is BENIGN and attributable to the retained NR-globalization line-search path: signal-dependent shot-noise realization at idle (idle output = pure amplified shot noise, so an FP-level operating-point difference reshuffles the noise samples) + HF-clip phase wiggle on the near-Nyquist sweep tail (worst deltas localized to idx ~178k-181k of 192k). dr-debuggenshmirtz measured step delta ~6e-4 vs main on the DETERMINISTIC (no-noise) signal; the harness runs --noise shot, which is why the captured idle residual is larger. Codegen still carries the NR globalization (line search + counter), so this deck stays DRIFT-EXPLAINED (nr_globalization_full).
audio_changed.uniquorn (unstable/pedals/uniquorn.cir,: TRIVIAL: potsweep only, +0.002 dB, corr 0.999748, max sample delta 8.6e-2 (sub-mV tail drift on the harder-converging pot positions). All other uniquorn programs identical. Benign NR-globalization drift.
